faqs.question: What do I get with the store template?
faqs.answer: A complete online store including category and product pages, variants, inventory management, shopping cart, checkout flow, and a friendly management system powered by Payload CMS.

faqs.question: What can I edit through the admin panel?
faqs.answer: You can independently manage the home page, the hero section, content sections, products, categories, prices, inventory, images, FAQs, and SEO data — with no code changes needed.

faqs.question: Does the store support products with sizes, colors, or other variants?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can define variant types like size and color for each product, with separate price and inventory per combination, and add more option types as your store needs.

faqs.question: Is the store fast and mobile-friendly?
faqs.answer: Yes. The store is built with Next.js and React, adapts to any screen size, and uses smart caching and revalidation to stay fast even as the catalog grows.

faqs.question: Is the store ready for Google SEO?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every page has managed metadata, a share image, and a canonical link, and a sitemap and structured data are generated automatically to help search engines understand the store and product content.

faqs.question: Are there subscription fees or a cut of sales?
faqs.answer: The store is open source and fully owned by you, so there's no built-in fee on your sales volume or dependency on a closed commerce platform. Third-party service and hosting costs depend on what you choose to use.

faqs.question: Can the store be extended later?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can add fields to products, new content types, pages, content blocks, and additional integrations, so the store can grow and change along with the business.

faqs.question: Does the store support analytics tools and order notifications?
faqs.answer: Yes. The template is ready to connect with Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, and TikTok Pixel, and includes infrastructure for sending messages and order confirmations based on your store settings.

categories.title: Nike
categories.description:
Our original Nike collection combines technological innovation with iconic design that has followed the world of sports for decades.
- Legendary Air Max models with visible air cushioning
- Advanced running shoes in the React line
- Advanced shock-absorption technology for every workout
Every pair combines quality materials and uncompromising comfort, whether for a daily workout or street style.

faqs.question: What's the difference between Air Max and React models?
faqs.answer: Air Max is based on visible air units that provide cushioning and a distinctive look, while React uses an especially soft polymer foam that gives a lighter, more flexible running feel.

faqs.question: Does Nike sizing match my regular size?
faqs.answer: Most Nike models tend to run slightly small compared to the standard, so it's sometimes recommended to size up by half a size, especially in running and basketball models.

faqs.question: How do I keep white canvas or leather shoes clean?
faqs.answer: Clean gently with a soft brush, a little soap, and lukewarm water, and avoid machine washing to preserve the shoe's structure and internal adhesives.

faqs.question: Which models are best suited for daily fitness training?
faqs.answer: The Metcon and Pegasus lines offer excellent support for multi-directional movement, good ankle stability, and a level of cushioning suited to both weight training and cardio.

categories.title: Adidas
categories.description: German heritage of precision and quality meets contemporary innovation. The Adidas collection includes the legendary Boost models known for maximum comfort, alongside the classic Samba and Gazelle lines that have come back to life as sought-after everyday fashion items.

faqs.question: What is Boost technology and how does it improve comfort?
faqs.answer: Boost is a unique foam midsole made of thousands of tiny energy capsules that provide especially high energy return and a soft cushioned feel under the foot with every step.

faqs.question: Are Samba and Gazelle models also suitable for sports activity?
faqs.answer: These are classic models originally designed for football and running, but today they're mainly used as everyday fashion sneakers and aren't recommended for intense training.

faqs.question: How do I know which Adidas size to order?
faqs.answer: It's best to use the brand's official size chart and measure your foot at the end of the day, when it's at its largest, for the most accurate fit.

faqs.question: What's the difference between a Boost sole and a Lightstrike sole?
faqs.answer: Lightstrike is a lightweight sole designed for fast, competitive runs, while Boost focuses on comfort and shock absorption for long-duration training and everyday use.

categories.title: Asics
categories.description:
Asics brings a rich Japanese heritage of precise running engineering, combining iconic archival designs with up-to-date performance technologies.
- GEL inserts placed at key pressure points
- A perfect balance of cushioning, stability, and refined finish
- Suitable for both athletic use and urban lifestyle

faqs.question: What makes Asics' GEL technology special?
faqs.answer: It refers to gel inserts placed at key pressure points in the sole, providing targeted shock absorption and improving stability on landing.

faqs.question: Are Asics archive models suitable for actual running?
faqs.answer: Most of the reissued models are based on older designs and are mainly intended for lifestyle use, so it's worth checking the technical spec of each model before intense use.

faqs.question: How do I choose the right size in Asics shoes?
faqs.answer: Asics tends to run fairly true to size, but it's still recommended to measure your foot at the end of the day and check the brand's official size chart before purchasing.

faqs.question: What's the difference between GEL-KAYANO models and GT models?
faqs.answer: The GEL-KAYANO line focuses on stability and support for feet prone to overpronation, while the GT line offers a broader balance between cushioning and flexibility for general daily running.

categories.title: New Balance
categories.description: New Balance combines a rich American running heritage with a retro-futuristic design language that's reclaiming the world of lifestyle fashion. From the legendary 990 models to technical collections inspired by the 2000s, every pair combines top-quality materials. The brand offers advanced shock-absorption technologies like ABZORB and FuelCell for maximum support. The distinctive aesthetic suits everyday use, work, and athletic settings alike.

faqs.question: What's the difference between the 990 models and the 574 models?
faqs.answer: The 990 line offers a higher level of cushioning and support at a higher price, while the 574 is a lighter, more accessible option mainly suited for everyday use.

faqs.question: Are New Balance shoes suitable for wide feet?
faqs.answer: The brand is known for dedicated wide options (Wide and Extra Wide) in many of its models, making it a popular choice for those who need extra room in the toe area.

faqs.question: What is ABZORB technology and how does it work?
faqs.answer: ABZORB is a foam sole designed to absorb shock on landing, providing a cushioned feel while maintaining responsiveness and stability throughout your stride.

faqs.question: How do I know if a certain model is meant for running or just lifestyle?
faqs.answer: It's worth checking the model's technical spec — dedicated running shoes will include details about support and shock absorption for training, while lifestyle models focus mainly on aesthetics and everyday comfort.
